whyItMatters: Encryption uses a hardcoded IV (iv = "1234567890123456"), so ciphertext patterns leak and nonce-reuse breaks modes.
actions: Generate the IV randomly per message with a CSPRNG draw.
Store the IV with the ciphertext; never reuse a (key, IV) pair.
Re-run the scan and confirm no literal IV remains outside test vectors.
verification: Rescan shows no literal IV outside test vectors, and captures show unique IVs.
